findings.text: §24's done-when requires only that a finding and a dimension disposed on the filed record before promotion are still disposed after it, which is the case `store_committed_review` already satisfies: a probe wrote a record, added `finding_dispositions` and `dimension_dispositions` to the committed file, re-stored the same body through `store_committed_review`, and read both dispositions back intact — so the case passes at base and the node's gate opens with no behaviour change
